messages.subject: Multiple box plots
parts:
I am trying to plot box plots from surveys at two locations ("site_name" in the df) in one graph.

I am attaching the df called "arand.all". The code below kinda works, but adding the 'group = site_name' argument to aes() in the first line does not give the correct behavior:

arand.all <- ggplot(accum.rand.all.gg, aes(x=factor(samples), y=value))

arand.all + geom_jitter(alpha = 0.25) + geom_boxplot(fill = "grey80",colour = "grey40",outlier.colour = "red", outlier.size = 2) +  xlab("\nSamples") + ylab("Species richness\n") + opts(title="Species Accumulation at \nFootprint and Piggy Banks\n") + theme_bw()

Just plotting the geom_jitter clearly illustrates the different groups:

arand.all + geom_jitter(alpha = 0.25)

I hope this is clear and reproducible enough. Any ideas?

Thanks,
--
Kevin Stierhoff

messages.subject: Re: Multiple box plots
parts:
hmm. that was a bit funky. i got it to work using just color or just fill, but setting both of those outside aes and then using group in aes seems to make it fail. I wouldnt have expected that.

hopefully you can get what you want from either of these versions, though they violate the fill and color you had specified.

accum.rand.all.gg <- arand.all$data

arand.all <- ggplot(accum.rand.all.gg, aes(x=as.factor(samples), y=value, fill=site_name))
arand.all + 
geom_boxplot(colour = "grey40", outlier.colour = "red", outlier.size = 2) +  
geom_jitter(alpha = 0.25) +
xlab(" Samples") + ylab("Species richness ") + opts(title="Species Accumulation at Footprint and Piggy Banks ") + theme_bw()

arand.all <- ggplot(accum.rand.all.gg, aes(x=as.factor(samples), y=value, color=site_name))
arand.all + 
geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = "red", outlier.size = 2, fill='grey') +  
geom_jitter(alpha = 0.25) +
xlab(" Samples") + ylab("Species richness ") + opts(title="Species Accumulation at Footprint and Piggy Banks ") + theme_bw()
